scenario: Approved external script with verified integrity
description: A synthetic external script is approved, originates from an authorised source and has verified integrity evidence.
safe_action: Allow the approved script to execute because its source, integrity and authorisation have been verified.

description: A synthetic script requests execution from a source that is not included in the authorised source list.
safe_action: Block script execution because the source is not authorised and integrity cannot be established.

description: A script is approved but its integrity evidence does not match the expected verified reference.
safe_action: Block execution and investigate the integrity mismatch before the script can be considered safe.

scenario: Approved script with missing audit evidence
description: A script has an approved status but lacks sufficient audit evidence to confirm its authorisation history.
safe_action: Require review and recover the missing authorisation evidence before allowing script execution.

description: An approved script remains disabled through an intentional configuration decision.
safe_action: Accept the disabled state because the script remains inactive under an authorised configuration.

description: A synthetic script configuration is incorrectly applied outside its intended environment boundary.
safe_action: Block script execution until environment isolation is restored and the approved configuration is verified.

description: An external script is awaiting formal approval and must not execute before the review is completed.
safe_action: Keep script execution disabled until the pending authorisation review has been completed.

scenario: Verified script with no execution request
description: An approved script has verified integrity and an authorised source, but execution has not been requested.
safe_action: Accept the inactive state while retaining verified provenance and preventing unnecessary script execution.

description: A script originates from an authorised source but its integrity has not been verified.
safe_action: Block execution until integrity has been verified independently of source authorisation.
